cohort: The study cohort comprised 33.3 million delivery hospitalisations from the 2010-2018 Nationwide Readmissions Database in the United States.
finding: Patients with ischaemic placental disease (IPD) had a substantially increased risk of readmission for depression within a year following delivery (HR, 2.39; 95% CI, 2.32-2.47), with the highest risk associated with preeclampsia with severe features.
